title: RunContext
description: Persisted by extract/convert (<base>.run-context.json + .md) so the `review` workflow can recompute the CURRENT run_id after the resolution store changes, WITHOUT re-prompting the reviewer for OCR / reconciliation / LLM flags (audit remediation H3). It is the extract-stage effective-input tuple (research §14, the authoritative definition) minus the applicable-resolution digest, which `review` derives from the current store. Deterministic body; no wall-clock. `review` never mutates it.

run_id.description: The run's run_id AT WRITE TIME (with whatever resolution digest applied then). `review` recomputes a possibly-different run_id from the fields below + the CURRENT applicable-resolution digest.

page_selection.description: Canonical normalized selector token, or 'all' — the same value folded into run_id (research §14).

extract_output_affecting_config.description: The EXTRACT-STAGE subset of research §14 output_affecting_config — the settings that determine the CED, the render, and therefore Human-Review verification. `gross_divergence_threshold` is NOT here (validate-stage only). run_id = sha256(source_sha256 ⧺ page_selection ⧺ tool_version ⧺ canonical_json(this object) ⧺ applicable_resolution_digest)[:16].

llm_model.description: Present (non-null) only when the LLM was reachable for reconciliation this run and thus affected the CED.
